question: Which of the following steps for micrometer adjustment is incorrect?

options.text: Open the micrometer using the friction stop.
Find the set screw and loosen it.
Insert the large end of the wrench into the hole on the outer cylinder.
Use the reciprocating wheel to rotate the cylinder until the zeros align.

solution:
__**Explanation:**__

**Micrometer:**

 
• A micrometer is a precision measuring instrument used to measure small dimensions with high accuracy. Adjusting a micrometer involves ensuring it is properly calibrated and aligned to deliver precise measurements. The adjustment process typically includes steps to align the zero markings, set the calibration, and ensure smooth operation of the components.
 
• A micrometer works on the principle of a screw mechanism. The rotation of the thimble causes the spindle to move axially. By measuring the distance the spindle travels, the micrometer provides highly accurate readings of the dimensions of an object. Proper adjustment of the micrometer is crucial to maintain its accuracy and functionality.
